---
title: "01 - Prepare TXG-MAPr upload; DEG counts (Table 1); volcano plots (Fig 2)"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r global setup, include=FALSE}
# ========== GLOBAL SETTINGS ==========

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  message = FALSE, 
  fig.width = 12, 
  fig.height = 8,
  cache = FALSE,
  error = FALSE,
  eval = TRUE
)

options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cran.rstudio.com/"))
options(width = 100)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

# ========== GLOBAL OUTPUT SETTINGS ==========
here::i_am("code/01_prepare_upload.Rmd")  # path to THIS Rmd from project root

params <- list(
  save_outputs = TRUE,
  results_dir = here::here("results", format(Sys.Date()))
)

if (params$save_outputs && !dir.exists(params$results_dir)) {
  dir.create(params$results_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ========== FILE PATHS ==========

earlypkd_file      <- here::here("data", "earlyPKDmodels.xlsx")
pkd1cko_file       <- here::here("data", "Pkd1cko_NoRapa_WT.xlsx")
orthologs_rat_file <- here::here("data", "ORTHOLOGS_RAT.txt")

# Load orthologs table, skipping comment lines
orthologs <- read.delim(orthologs_rat_file, comment.char = "#", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)
# Deduplicate column names explicitly
colnames(orthologs) <- make.names(colnames(orthologs), unique = TRUE)

# Keep all rows, including those with missing or multiple Ensembl IDs
ortholog_map <- orthologs %>%
  select(
    RAT_GENE_NCBI_GENE_ID, RAT_GENE_SYMBOL,
    RAT_GENE_ENSEMBL_GENE_ID,
    MOUSE_GENE_NCBI_GENE_ID, MOUSE_GENE_SYMBOL,
    MOUSE_GENE_ENSEMBL_GENE_ID
  )

results_main <- list()

# Load raw Excel data 

# Load early data 
results_main$data_early <- read_excel(earlypkd_file, sheet = "DEGs", skip = 2,
                                      col_names = c(
                                        "ensembl_id", "symbol", "description",
                                        "logFC_Wk1", "FC_Wk1", "padj_Wk1",
                                        "logFC_Wk2", "FC_Wk2", "padj_Wk2",
                                        "logFC_Wk5", "FC_Wk5", "padj_Wk5"
                                      ))

# Load early mod-sev
results_main$data_mod_sev <- read_excel(pkd1cko_file, sheet = "All_Genes", skip = 2,
                                      col_names = c(
                                        "ensembl_id", "symbol", "description",
                                        "logFC_NoRapa_Short", "FC_NoRapa_Short", "padj_NoRapa_Short",
                                        "logFC_NoRapa_Long", "FC_NoRapa_Long", "padj_NoRapa_Long"
                                      ))


# dataset reshaping
reshape_early <- function(df) {
  long_df <- bind_rows(
    df %>% select(ensembl_id, symbol, log2fc = logFC_Wk1, padj = padj_Wk1) %>% mutate(experiment = "PKD_wk2", time = 1),
    df %>% select(ensembl_id, symbol, log2fc = logFC_Wk2, padj = padj_Wk2) %>% mutate(experiment = "PKD_wk3", time = 2),
    df %>% select(ensembl_id, symbol, log2fc = logFC_Wk5, padj = padj_Wk5) %>% mutate(experiment = "PKD_wk6", time = 3)
  )
  long_df %>%
    mutate(
      conc = 0,
      pvalue = 0
    ) %>%
    rename(gene_id = ensembl_id, gene_symbol = symbol) %>%
    select(experiment, gene_id, gene_symbol, time, conc, log2fc, pvalue, padj)
}

reshape_modsev <- function(df) {
  long_df <- bind_rows(
    df %>% select(ensembl_id, symbol, log2fc = logFC_NoRapa_Short, padj = padj_NoRapa_Short) %>% mutate(experiment = "PKD_Moderate", time = 4),
    df %>% select(ensembl_id, symbol, log2fc = logFC_NoRapa_Long, padj = padj_NoRapa_Long) %>% mutate(experiment = "PKD_Advanced", time = 5)
  )
  long_df %>%
    mutate(
      conc = 0,
      pvalue = 0
    ) %>%
    rename(gene_id = ensembl_id, gene_symbol = symbol) %>%
    select(experiment, gene_id, gene_symbol, time, conc, log2fc, pvalue, padj)
}

# Full mouse-to-rat table
txg_mapr_mouse <- bind_rows(
  reshape_early(results_main$data_early),
  reshape_modsev(results_main$data_mod_sev)
) %>%
  mutate(mouse_gene_id = gene_id)  # Keep for traceability

# Step 1: Match on SYMBOL
matched_symbol <- txg_mapr_mouse %>%
  inner_join(ortholog_map, by = c("gene_symbol" = "MOUSE_GENE_SYMBOL"))

unmatched_symbol <- anti_join(txg_mapr_mouse, matched_symbol, by = colnames(txg_mapr_mouse))






# Step 2: Match remaining on ENSEMBL
matched_ensembl <- unmatched_symbol %>%
  inner_join(ortholog_map, by = c("mouse_gene_id" = "MOUSE_GENE_ENSEMBL_GENE_ID"))

unmatched_ensembl <- anti_join(unmatched_symbol, matched_ensembl, by = colnames(txg_mapr_mouse))

# Step 3: Match remaining on ENTREZ
matched_entrez <- unmatched_ensembl %>%
  mutate(mouse_gene_id_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mouse_gene_id))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mouse_gene_id_num)) %>%
  inner_join(ortholog_map, by = c("mouse_gene_id_num" = "MOUSE_GENE_NCBI_GENE_ID"))

# Combine all mapped
mapped_all <- bind_rows(matched_symbol, matched_ensembl, matched_entrez)


# Final rat-formatted output
txg_mapr_upload <- mapped_all %>%
  mutate(gene_id = RAT_GENE_SYMBOL) %>%
  select(experiment, gene_id, time, conc, log2fc, pvalue, padj, mouse_gene_id)

# Count total and mapped rows per experiment
total_counts <- txg_mapr_mouse %>%
  group_by(experiment) %>%
  summarise(total_genes = n(), .groups = "drop")

mapped_counts <- txg_mapr_upload %>%
  group_by(experiment) %>%
  summarise(mapped_genes = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Merge and compute loss stats
mapping_stats <- total_counts %>%
  left_join(mapped_counts, by = "experiment") %>%
  mutate(
    genes_lost   = total_genes - mapped_genes,
    percent_lost = round(100 * genes_lost / total_genes, 2)
  )

print(mapping_stats)  ########################################<-<-<- this is table 1

# Export final rat-formatted table (excluding mouse_gene_id from file, but not from object)
write.table(
  txg_mapr_upload %>% select(-mouse_gene_id),
  file = file.path(params$results_dir, "txg_mapr_upload_rat_symbols.txt"),  ####################################<- file used to upload in the WGCNA
  sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
)

# Optional: if you want to keep intermediate versions
# write.table(txg_mapr_mouse, file = ..., ...)
# write.table(mapped_all, file = ..., ...)

# Save ortholog map (cleaned)
dir.create(here::here("data"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
saveRDS(ortholog_map, file = here::here("data", "orthologs_df.rds"))



# ============================
# EXPORT: Gene mapping summary (merged) to Excel
# ============================

# Label mapping status
mapped_all$mapping_status <- "mapped"
unmatched_symbol$mapping_status <- "unmapped"

# Match column structure and merge
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(mapped_all), colnames(unmatched_symbol))
merged_genes <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  mapped_all[, c(common_cols, "mapping_status")],
  unmatched_symbol[, c(common_cols, "mapping_status")]
)

# Recalculate unmapped directly, safely
mapping_summary <- mapping_stats %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    unmapped_genes = total_genes - mapped_genes,
    percent_mapped = round(100 * mapped_genes / total_genes, 2),
    percent_unmapped = round(100 * (total_genes - mapped_genes) / total_genes, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Save output to results_dir ########################################################<--------------------- supplementary table 2
write.xlsx(
  x = list(
    "Gene Mapping Status" = merged_genes,
    "Summary by Condition" = mapping_summary
  ),
  file = file.path(params$results_dir, "txgmapr_gene_mapping_summary.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

```

```{r deg genes quantification Log2fc > 1 and padj < 0.05}

# Mouse-space table built in the script: txg_mapr_mouse
# uses gene_symbol
deg_counts_mouse <- txg_mapr_mouse %>%
  dplyr::group_by(experiment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_genes    = dplyr::n_distinct(gene_symbol),
    n_up_1p5   = dplyr::n_distinct(gene_symbol[log2fc >=  1 & padj < 0.05]),
    n_down_1p5 = dplyr::n_distinct(gene_symbol[log2fc <= -1 & padj < 0.05]),
    n_abs_1p5  = n_up_1p5 + n_down_1p5,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(experiment)


# Save output to results_dir
write.table(
  deg_counts_mouse,
  file = file.path(params$results_dir, "deg_counts_mouse.txt"),
  sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
## Volcano plot per experiment with top 10 labels, saved to results/
## Volcano plots: top 10 up + top 10 down per experiment (mouse only)
## Uses: txg_mapr_mouse with columns: experiment, gene_symbol, log2fc, padj

thr_logfc <- 1.5
thr_padj  <- 0.05

# ensure results dir
results_dir <- params$results_dir
if (!dir.exists(results_dir)) dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE)

volcano_plot_two_sided_top10 <- function(df, experiment_name, gene_col = "gene_symbol") {
  df_exp <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$experiment == experiment_name) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mlog10p = -log10(pmax(.data$padj, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      sig = dplyr::case_when(
        .data$padj < thr_padj & .data$log2fc >=  thr_logfc ~ "Up",
        .data$padj < thr_padj & .data$log2fc <= -thr_logfc ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )

  top_up <- df_exp %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$padj < thr_padj, .data$log2fc >= thr_logfc) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$padj, dplyr::desc(abs(.data$log2fc))) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)

  top_down <- df_exp %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$padj < thr_padj, .data$log2fc <= -thr_logfc) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$padj, dplyr::desc(abs(.data$log2fc))) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)

  top_labels <- dplyr::bind_rows(top_up, top_down)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_exp, ggplot2::aes(x = .data$log2fc, y = .data$mlog10p)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = .data$sig), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.3) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = c(-thr_logfc, thr_logfc), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey50") +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(thr_padj), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey50") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = top_labels,
      ggplot2::aes(label = .data[[gene_col]]),
      max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.2, min.segment.length = 0
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(Down = "#3b82f6", NS = "grey75", Up = "#ef4444")) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("Volcano: ", experiment_name),
      x = "log2 fold change",
      y = "-log10(adjusted p)",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "top")

  out_path <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("volcano_", experiment_name, "_top10eachside_1p5padj0p05.png"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(out_path, plot = p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  message("Saved: ", out_path)
  invisible(p)
}

# run for all experiments in the mouse table
invisible(lapply(unique(txg_mapr_mouse$experiment), function(e) {
  volcano_plot_two_sided_top10(txg_mapr_mouse, e, gene_col = "gene_symbol")
}))



```
